senses.en: At any time, especially in questions and negative statements.
Continuously or always, often describing an ongoing change.
Used to emphasize surprise in a question.

ex.en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
ex.zh: 你曾经在山上看过日出吗？

ex.en: Public transport is more important than ever as growing cities struggle with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 随着不断扩张的城市面临交通拥堵和空气污染，公共交通比以往任何时候都更重要。

col: more than ever｜比以往任何时候都更
tip: 问经历常用Have you ever…；肯定句不随意代替always。

senses.en: referring to all members of a group individually
used to show how regularly something happens
used to emphasize all possibilities or a strong degree

ex.en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都带了一件最喜欢的玩具去野餐。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that every student has access to reliable internet services for learning.
ex.zh: 政府应确保每个学生都能使用可靠的互联网服务进行学习。

col: every reason to believe｜充分的理由相信
tip: every后通常接单数可数名词，谓语也用单数。

senses.en: Every person in a group, or all people generally.

ex.en: Everybody is waiting outside for the doors to open.
ex.zh: 所有人都在外面等着开门。

ex.en: Public libraries should offer accessible services so that everybody can benefit from opportunities for lifelong learning.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应提供无障碍服务，让每个人都能受益于终身学习的机会。

tip: 作主语时谓语用单数：Everybody is ready。

senses.en: All things or all the things in a particular situation.
The most important thing in someone's life or situation.

ex.en: Everything in my bag got wet during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨把我包里的东西全弄湿了。

ex.en: Although digital resources are valuable, students should not assume that everything they read online is accurate.
ex.zh: 虽然数字资源很有价值，但学生不应认为自己在网上读到的一切都准确无误。

col: mean everything to someone｜对某人无比重要
tip: 作主语时谓语用单数：Everything is ready。

senses.en: in, at, or to all places

ex.en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们到处找，结果小猫就在沙发底下。

ex.en: Although digital services are expanding rapidly, reliable internet access is not yet available everywhere.
ex.zh: 尽管数字服务正在迅速扩展，可靠的互联网接入仍未覆盖所有地方。

tip: everywhere是副词，前面通常不加in或at。

senses.en: Precisely, with no difference or error.
Used to confirm that something is completely correct.

ex.en: This jacket is exactly the colour I wanted.
ex.zh: 这件夹克正是我想要的颜色。

ex.en: Researchers must record exactly how much energy each household uses to ensure reliable comparisons between regions.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须准确记录每户家庭的能耗，以确保地区之间的比较可靠。

tip: not exactly常表示并非完全，也可委婉否定。

senses.en: A formal test of knowledge or ability.

ex.en: I have a maths exam on Friday morning.
ex.zh: 我周五上午有一场数学考试。

ex.en: Schools should consider practical skills alongside exam results when assessing students' overall progress.
ex.zh: 学校在评估学生的整体进步时，应将实践技能与考试成绩一并考虑。

col: revise for an exam｜复习备考
tip: exam是examination的常用缩写；参加考试用take。

senses.en: Something specific that shows what a general idea means
A person or action that others can learn from or copy

ex.en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
ex.zh: 你能给我举一个健康早餐的例子吗？

ex.en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。

tip: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

senses.en: Extremely good or of very high quality.

ex.en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
ex.zh: 这汤好喝极了，所以我又点了一碗。

ex.en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。

tip: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

senses.en: Not including a particular person or thing.
Used to introduce a fact limiting what was just said.

ex.en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
ex.zh: 除了我弟弟，大家都想走路回家。

ex.en: The proposed transport policy benefits most residents, except those living in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 拟议的交通政策惠及大多数居民，但偏远农村社区的居民除外。

tip: except排除在外；besides表示另外还包括。

senses.en: to give something and receive something else in return
an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas
a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded

ex.en: Can I exchange this shirt for a smaller size?
ex.zh: 我能把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗？

ex.en: International exchange programmes allow students to experience different cultures and develop greater confidence in communicating.
ex.zh: 国际交流项目让学生体验不同文化，并增强他们沟通时的信心。

tip: exchange A for B表示用A换B，注意介词for。

senses.en: Feeling very happy and enthusiastic about something.

ex.en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
ex.zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。

ex.en: Students are often more excited about learning when lessons involve practical experiments and opportunities for discovery.
ex.zh: 当课程包含实践实验和探索机会时，学生往往对学习更有热情。

tip: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

senses.en: Making someone feel eager, enthusiastic, or thrilled.

ex.en: The final minutes of the match were incredibly exciting.
ex.zh: 比赛最后几分钟精彩刺激极了。

ex.en: Advances in renewable energy offer exciting opportunities for young engineers seeking to address global environmental challenges.
ex.zh: 可再生能源的进步为希望应对全球环境挑战的年轻工程师提供了令人振奋的机会。

tip: exciting形容令人兴奋的事物；excited形容人的感受。

senses.en: a reason given to explain or defend a fault
forgive someone for a mistake or impolite behaviour
allow someone to avoid a duty or leave

ex.en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
ex.zh: 他为晚餐迟到找了个借口。

ex.en: Limited funding should not become an excuse for neglecting essential maintenance in schools and public hospitals.
ex.zh: 资金有限不应成为忽视学校和公立医院必要维护工作的借口。

col: excuse someone from｜准许某人免于
tip: 名词末尾读/s/，动词读/z/；excuse me常用于礼貌打断。

senses.en: Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills.
To do physical activity to stay healthy or become stronger.
To use a right, power, ability, or quality.

ex.en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
ex.zh: 我步行去商店，顺便锻炼一下。

ex.en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。

tip: 泛指运动时不可数；一项练习或一套动作中的动作可数。

senses.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

ex.en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
ex.zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。

ex.en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
ex.zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。

tip: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

senses.en: To be real or present in the world.
To stay alive, especially with very limited resources.

ex.en: Do you think creatures like these really exist?
ex.zh: 你觉得这样的生物真的存在吗？

ex.en: Significant differences in access to healthcare still exist between rural communities and major urban centres.
ex.zh: 农村社区与主要城市中心在医疗服务的可及性方面仍存在显著差异。

col: exist in nature｜存在于自然界
exist on limited resources｜靠有限资源维生
tip: 是不及物动词，不用被动语态；“不存在”用does not exist。

senses.en: a door or passage used to leave a place
to leave a place or close a computer program

ex.en: We found the exit at the back of the cinema.
ex.zh: 我们在电影院后部找到了出口。

ex.en: Public buildings must have clearly visible emergency exits so that occupants can leave safely during an evacuation.
ex.zh: 公共建筑必须设有清晰可见的紧急出口，以便楼内人员在疏散时安全离开。

tip: 名词指“出口”，动词指“离开”；不要与 exist 混淆。

senses.en: to believe that something will probably happen
to regard something as necessary or reasonably required
to believe someone or something will arrive soon

ex.en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
ex.zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。

ex.en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
ex.zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。

col: expect to do something｜预计做某事
expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事
tip: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

senses.en: costing a large amount of money

ex.en: These boots are too expensive for my budget.
ex.zh: 这双靴子太贵，超出了我的预算。

ex.en: Housing in major cities is becoming increasingly expensive, forcing many young workers to live farther from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 大城市的住房越来越贵，迫使许多年轻职工住到离工作地点更远的地方。

col: an expensive mistake｜代价高昂的错误
tip: 物品贵用expensive，价格高用high。

senses.en: knowledge or skill gained by doing things
something that happens to you or that you do
to have something happen to you or feel something

ex.en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。

ex.en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

col: a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历
tip: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

senses.en: a test designed to discover something or check an idea
test ideas or methods to see what happens

ex.en: Our science experiment showed how roots grow towards water.
ex.zh: 我们的科学实验展示了植物根部如何朝水源生长。

ex.en: Schools should allow students to experiment with different materials before explaining the scientific principles involved.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生先尝试使用不同材料，再讲解其中的科学原理。

col: experiment with materials｜尝试使用各种材料
tip: 动词接with表示尝试；名词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: to make something clear or easy to understand
to give or be the reason why something happens

ex.en: Could you explain how this coffee machine works?
ex.zh: 你能说明一下这台咖啡机怎么用吗？

ex.en: Differences in access to healthcare may partly explain why life expectancy varies considerably between regions.
ex.zh: 医疗服务可及性的差异，可能在一定程度上解释不同地区预期寿命差距较大的原因。

col: explain something to someone｜向某人解释某事
tip: 说explain something to someone，不说explain someone。

senses.en: Travel around a place to discover what it is like
Examine an idea or issue carefully to learn more

ex.en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们花了一下午探访港口附近的狭窄街巷。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在选择深造科目前探索不同的职业方向。

tip: 作及物动词时直接接地点或问题，不加about。

senses.en: Show or communicate a thought, feeling, or opinion.
Providing a faster service than usual.
Clearly and directly stated.

ex.en: Leah expressed her thanks with a warm smile.
ex.zh: 莉娅用一个温暖的微笑表达了谢意。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to express their opinions on decisions that affect their education.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生有机会对影响其教育的决策发表意见。

tip: express作动词直接接宾语，如express your views。

senses.en: added to the usual or necessary amount
more than usual, or in addition to the normal amount
an additional item, or a background actor in a film

ex.en: I packed an extra sweater because the evenings get cold.
ex.zh: 我多带了一件毛衣，因为晚上会冷。

ex.en: Schools should provide extra support for students who struggle to access learning materials at home.
ex.zh: 学校应为在家难以获取学习资料的学生提供额外支持。

tip: 形容词指额外的；pay extra中作副词。

senses.en: one of the two body parts used for seeing
an ability to notice or judge particular qualities
to look at someone or something with particular interest

ex.en: She closed her eyes and listened to the rain.
ex.zh: 她闭上眼睛，听着雨声。

ex.en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
ex.zh: 设计师需要善于观察细节，才能打造既美观又便于所有人使用的公共空间。

col: keep an eye on｜留意；照看
an eye for detail｜对细节的敏锐观察力
catch someone's eye｜引起某人的注意
tip: an eye for表示鉴赏力；keep an eye on表示照看。

senses.en: The front of the head, including eyes, nose, and mouth.
To encounter or deal with a difficult situation.
To look or point in a particular direction.

ex.en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
ex.zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。

ex.en: Many coastal cities face increasing risks from flooding as sea levels rise and extreme weather becomes more frequent.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升和极端天气日益频繁，许多沿海城市面临越来越大的洪水风险。

tip: 面对困难可说face difficulties或be faced with difficulties。

senses.en: Something known or proved to be true.

ex.en: We checked the facts before booking our train tickets.
ex.zh: 我们核实了相关情况后才订火车票。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from opinions when evaluating information shared through digital media.
ex.zh: 学生在评估数字媒体传播的信息时，应学会区分事实和观点。

tip: the fact that后接完整从句，说明事实内容。

senses.en: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured.

ex.en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。

ex.en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
ex.zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。

tip: 复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。

senses.en: to be unsuccessful or not do something required
to not pass a test, or give an unsuccessful grade
to stop working properly or become weaker

ex.en: The cake failed to rise despite an extra egg.
ex.zh: 尽管多加了一个鸡蛋，蛋糕还是没发起来。

ex.en: Recycling programmes often fail when local authorities do not provide clear guidance or convenient collection services.
ex.zh: 地方政府若不提供清晰指导或便捷的收集服务，回收计划往往会失败。

col: fail to do something｜未能做某事
fail to meet expectations｜未达到预期
tip: fail to do表示未能做；fail an exam表示考试不及格。

senses.en: treating people equally or reasonably
having pale skin or light hair
an event where people display or sell goods and services

ex.en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
ex.zh: 我们轮流选游戏，以保证公平。

ex.en: A fair education system should give every child access to quality teaching, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 公平的教育制度应让每个孩子都能获得优质教学，不受家庭收入影响。

tip: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

senses.en: To move downward, lose balance, or decrease.
An act of falling or a decrease in amount.
The season between summer and winter, especially in American English.

ex.en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
ex.zh: 金黄的叶子落在我们屋外的小路上。

ex.en: Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓励家庭改善隔热条件并安装高效供暖系统，能源消耗可能会下降。

tip: 过去式fell，过去分词fallen；秋天英式常用autumn。

senses.en: easy to recognise because you have encountered it before
having knowledge or experience of something

ex.en: I heard a familiar voice outside the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 我听见厨房门外传来一个熟悉的声音。

ex.en: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
ex.zh: 熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。

tip: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

senses.en: a group of people related to one another
a group of related animals, plants, languages, or other things

ex.en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。

ex.en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。

tip: family作整体用单数；英式英语强调成员时可用复数。

senses.en: Known by many people.

ex.en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
ex.zh: 这个村庄以美味的苹果派闻名。

ex.en: Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.
ex.zh: 著名地标吸引着国际游客，但旅游收入也应惠及周边社区。

tip: famous for接出名的原因，famous as接身份。

senses.en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing
a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow
to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger

ex.en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
ex.zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。

ex.en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
ex.zh: 体育迷可以通过支持社区球队、参与共同活动来增强当地社区的凝聚力。

tip: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。

senses.en: At, to, or over a great distance.
To a much greater degree.
More distant from you or a particular point.

ex.en: We walked so far that our feet began to ache.
ex.zh: 我们走了很远，走得脚都开始疼了。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can make commuting far more affordable for people who live outside major city centres.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以让住在大城市中心以外的人通勤时省下很多钱。

tip: far可修饰比较级，如far better；不用far good。

senses.en: The money paid for a journey on public transport.
To perform or experience a particular level of success.
Food of a particular kind served in a place.

ex.en: I had just enough coins for the bus fare.
ex.zh: 我的硬币刚好够付公交车费。

ex.en: Reducing train fares could encourage commuters to leave their cars at home and use public transport.
ex.zh: 降低火车票价可以鼓励通勤者不开车，改用公共交通。

tip: fare是交通票价；fee多指服务费或学费。

senses.en: land and buildings used for growing crops or raising animals
to grow crops or raise animals for food or other products

ex.en: We bought fresh eggs from a nearby farm.
ex.zh: 我们从附近的农场买了新鲜鸡蛋。

ex.en: Small farms can support local food supplies while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.
ex.zh: 小型农场既能支持当地食品供应，也能为农村社区创造就业机会。

col: work on a farm｜在农场工作
tip: 表示在农场通常用on a farm，不用in。

senses.en: someone who grows crops or raises animals on a farm

ex.en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
ex.zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。

ex.en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
ex.zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。

tip: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。

senses.en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time
A particular way of doing something
Make or shape something, often using simple materials

ex.en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
ex.zh: 我姐姐关注时尚，但很少买昂贵的衣服。

ex.en: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
ex.zh: 时装行业可以通过生产耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料来减少对环境的影响。

col: in a similar fashion｜以类似的方式
tip: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。

senses.en: moving or happening at high speed
at high speed or within a short time
to eat no food for a period of time

ex.en: We caught a fast train and arrived before lunch.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班快车，在午饭前就到了。

ex.en: Fast internet connections allow rural businesses to reach wider markets and compete with companies in major cities.
ex.zh: 高速网络连接使乡村企业能够进入更广阔的市场，并与大城市的公司竞争。

tip: fast本身可作副词，不能说fastly。

senses.en: to close or attach something securely

ex.en: Please fasten your seat belt before we leave.
ex.zh: 出发前请系好安全带。

ex.en: Passengers must fasten their seat belts during takeoff and landing to reduce the risk of injury.
ex.zh: 乘客在飞机起飞和降落时必须系好安全带，以降低受伤风险。

col: fasten a seat belt｜系好安全带
tip: t不发音；反义词unfasten表示解开。

senses.en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking
having a large amount of body fat

ex.en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
ex.zh: 让汤凉下来，再撇去油脂。

ex.en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
ex.zh: 虽然人体需要一定的脂肪，但摄入过多会增加某些健康问题的风险。

tip: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。

senses.en: A male parent.
A man who established or greatly influenced a field.
To become the biological father of a child.

ex.en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can allow fathers to take a more active role in raising their children.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以让父亲更积极地参与养育子女。

col: the father of modern medicine｜现代医学之父
tip: father较正式，dad更口语化；父亲节用Father's Day。

senses.en: Something helpful you do for someone.
Approval, support, or preference shown towards someone or something.
To prefer, support, or give an advantage to someone or something.

ex.en: Could you do me a favour and water my plants?
ex.zh: 你能帮我一个忙，给我的植物浇浇水吗？

ex.en: Many residents favour investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion and improve air quality.
ex.zh: 许多居民支持投资公共交通，因为这有助于缓解拥堵并改善空气质量。

col: do someone a favour｜帮某人一个忙
favour one option over another｜更倾向于某个选项
tip: 英式拼写为favour，美式为favor；帮忙用do。

senses.en: liked more than any other of the same kind
a person or thing someone likes best
the competitor considered most likely to win

ex.en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。

ex.en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆让读者无需额外花费，既能发现新作家，也能重读自己最喜爱的书。

col: a firm favourite｜一直备受喜爱的人或物
the favourite to win｜夺冠热门
tip: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。

senses.en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening.
To feel afraid or worried about someone or something.

ex.en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
ex.zh: 她因为恐高而握住了我的手。

ex.en: Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.
ex.zh: 对失败的恐惧可能使学生不敢提问，在竞争激烈的学习环境中尤其如此。

col: fear for someone's safety｜担心某人的安全
tip: fear sth是害怕某事；fear for sb是为某人担忧。

senses.en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food.
Food given to farm animals.
A regularly updated stream of online content.

ex.en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
ex.zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。

ex.en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。

senses.en: Experience an emotion, physical sensation, or personal belief.
Touch something to discover its texture, shape, or position.
The quality something has when touched or experienced.

ex.en: I feel much warmer with this soft blanket.
ex.zh: 盖着这条柔软的毯子，我觉得暖和多了。

ex.en: Residents often feel safer when public spaces are well lit and regularly maintained by local authorities.
ex.zh: 当公共空间照明充足且由地方政府定期维护时，居民往往更有安全感。

col: feel strongly about｜对……有强烈看法
feel like doing something｜想做某事
get a feel for｜逐渐了解
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为felt；feel后可直接接形容词。

senses.en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs.
An animal or person of the female sex.

ex.en: The female lion rested beside her cubs in the shade.
ex.zh: 母狮和幼狮一起在阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Encouraging female students to study engineering can help reduce gender inequality in the technology sector.
ex.zh: 鼓励女生学习工程学有助于减少科技行业中的性别不平等。

tip: 指成年女性通常用women；female作定语较自然。

senses.en: A barrier enclosing land or separating areas.
To surround or divide an area with a fence.
To fight with special swords as a sport.

ex.en: Our dog watched the neighbours through the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 我们的狗透过木栅栏看着邻居。

ex.en: Installing fences around protected habitats can reduce conflict between local farmers and endangered wildlife.
ex.zh: 在受保护栖息地周围安装围栏，可以减少当地农民与濒危野生动物之间的冲突。

col: put up a fence｜竖起围栏
fence off an area｜用围栏隔开一片区域
tip: sit on the fence比喻保持中立、不表态。

senses.en: A boat carrying passengers or vehicles across water regularly.
To carry people or goods between places, often repeatedly.

ex.en: We took the ferry across the lake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们乘渡船穿过了湖。

ex.en: Reliable ferry services connect island communities with mainland hospitals, schools, and employment opportunities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 可靠的轮渡服务全年将岛屿社区与大陆的医院、学校和就业机会连接起来。

tip: 复数为ferries；动词也可指用车反复接送。

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。

ex.en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
ex.zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

col: hold a festival｜举办节庆活动
tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

senses.en: a body temperature higher than normal, usually caused by illness
intense excitement shared by a person or group

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
ex.zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。

ex.en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。

tip: 表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。

senses.en: Not many; a small number of countable things.
A small number of people or things.

ex.en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。

ex.en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
ex.zh: 很少有农村社区能获得大城市所提供的专科医疗服务。

col: few and far between｜少之又少
tip: few表几乎没有，a few表有几个；均接可数名词复数。

senses.en: an area of land used for crops or farm animals
a particular area of study or work
an area of ground used for playing a sport

ex.en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
ex.zh: 我们看着羊群在小屋后面的牧场上吃草。

ex.en: Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源领域的研究可以创造就业机会，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 表示研究或工作领域时，常用in the field of。

senses.en: To use physical force against another person or group.
To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal.
An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.

ex.en: The two cats fought over a sunny window seat.
ex.zh: 两只猫为了窗边一个有阳光的位置打了起来。

ex.en: Governments should fight poverty by improving access to education, healthcare, and stable employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 政府应通过改善教育和医疗服务的可及性、增加稳定就业机会来消除贫困。

col: get into a fight｜卷入打斗
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为fought；fight for表示争取。

senses.en: a number expressing an amount, especially in official information
a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
ex.zh: 她核对了账单上的最终金额。

ex.en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
ex.zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

senses.en: Make or become full
Occupy an empty position or meet a particular need

ex.en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
ex.zh: 请把水壶装满水，给客人们喝。

ex.en: Local training programmes can help fill vacancies in essential services such as healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 地方培训项目可以帮助填补医疗和教育等基本服务领域的职位空缺。

col: fill in a form｜填写表格
fill a vacancy｜填补职位空缺
tip: fill A with B表示用B装满A；be filled with表示充满。

senses.en: a story or events recorded as moving pictures
to record moving pictures using a camera
a thin layer, or material used to record photographs

ex.en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

ex.en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
ex.zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。

col: a thin film of oil｜一层薄薄的油膜
tip: 表示电影时，film偏英式，movie偏美式。

senses.en: coming last in a series or process
settled and not open to further change or discussion
a competition's last match, or an examination ending a course

ex.en: We packed the final box and locked the door.
ex.zh: 我们装好最后一个箱子，锁上了门。

ex.en: The final stage of the research involved comparing energy consumption across several types of housing.
ex.zh: 研究的最后阶段是比较几种不同类型住房的能源消耗。

tip: finally是副词；final作名词可指决赛或期末考试。

senses.en: After a long wait, delay, or effort.
Used to introduce the last point or action.

ex.en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
ex.zh: 找了一上午后，我终于找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 最后，政府应投资建设可靠的公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。

tip: 表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。

senses.en: To discover something or locate what you were looking for.
To have a particular opinion or experience of something.
Something useful or valuable that someone discovers.

ex.en: I finally found my keys inside my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我终于在外套口袋里找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 许多学生觉得网络课程很方便，但有些人在缺少课堂互动时难以保持学习动力。

col: find a solution｜找到解决办法
find it difficult to｜觉得做某事困难
a valuable find｜有价值的发现物
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为found；find＋宾语＋形容词。

senses.en: Good, satisfactory, healthy, or of high quality.
Made of very small particles or having little thickness.
Money that must be paid as punishment for breaking rules.

ex.en: I feel fine now, so let's go for a walk.
ex.zh: 我现在感觉挺好的，我们去散步吧。

ex.en: A substantial fine may discourage companies from dumping industrial waste into rivers and damaging local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 高额罚款可能会阻止企业向河流倾倒工业废物、破坏当地生态系统。

tip: fine作动词也指罚款：fine sb for sth。

senses.en: one of the long movable parts of a hand
to touch or handle something with your fingers

ex.en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
ex.zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。

ex.en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
ex.zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。

col: point a finger at｜用手指指向；指责
tip: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

senses.en: to complete something or reach its end
the final part or end of something
the appearance or texture of a completed surface

ex.en: I'll finish washing the dishes before we go.
ex.zh: 我们出门前，我会把碗洗完。

ex.en: Students who finish their assignments early have more time to review feedback and improve their understanding.
ex.zh: 提前完成作业的学生有更多时间查看反馈并加深理解。

tip: 表示做完某事用finish doing，不用finish to do。

senses.en: Burning that produces heat and light, sometimes causing damage.
To make someone leave their job.
To shoot a gun or launch a weapon.

ex.en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们在炉火旁暖手。

ex.en: Regular safety inspections can reduce the risk of fire in older residential buildings with outdated electrical systems.
ex.zh: 定期安全检查可以降低电气系统老化的旧住宅楼发生火灾的风险。

tip: catch fire指开始着火；be on fire指正在燃烧。

senses.en: A man whose job is to put out fires.

ex.en: The fireman rescued a kitten from the smoky kitchen.
ex.zh: 这名男消防员从烟雾弥漫的厨房里救出了一只小猫。

ex.en: The fireman explained that regular safety inspections could prevent many accidents in residential buildings.
ex.zh: 这名男消防员解释说，定期安全检查可以预防住宅楼内的许多事故。

col: a brave fireman｜勇敢的男消防员
a volunteer fireman｜志愿男消防员
tip: 复数为firemen；现代通用表达多用中性的firefighter。

senses.en: an object that burns or explodes with bright colours outdoors

ex.en: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
ex.zh: 一枚烟花在湖面上空绽放，洒下金色火花。

ex.en: Public firework displays can attract visitors, although their noise may disturb local residents and wildlife.
ex.zh: 公共焰火表演可以吸引游客，但其噪声可能打扰当地居民和野生动物。

tip: 单枚烟花可数；泛指烟花或焰火表演常用fireworks。

senses.en: coming before all others in order or time
before anything or anyone else

ex.en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
ex.zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。

ex.en: Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.
ex.zh: 政府应先改善公共交通，再鼓励居民放弃私家车。

tip: at first指起初；first可用于列举第一点。

senses.en: an animal living in water with fins; its edible flesh
to try to catch fish

ex.en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 我们看着小鱼在木桥下游动。

ex.en: Eating locally caught fish can support coastal communities, provided that fishing practices protect marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 只要捕捞方式能保护海洋生态系统，食用本地捕获的鱼就能支持沿海社区。

tip: 表示多条鱼通常仍用fish；鱼肉为不可数名词。

senses.en: someone who catches fish for work or pleasure

ex.en: The fisherman pulled his net onto the wooden boat.
ex.zh: 渔民把渔网拉上了木船。

ex.en: Each fisherman in the coastal village depends on healthy marine ecosystems to maintain a reliable income.
ex.zh: 这个沿海村庄的每位渔民都依靠健康的海洋生态系统来维持稳定收入。

tip: 复数为fishermen；中性表达可用fisher。

senses.en: To be the right size, shape, or type for something.
Physically healthy and strong, especially through exercise.
Suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.

ex.en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
ex.zh: 即使穿着厚袜子，这双靴子也非常合脚。

ex.en: Public exercise facilities can help older adults stay fit while strengthening social connections within their communities.
ex.zh: 公共健身设施可以帮助老年人保持健康，同时加强他们与社区内其他人的联系。

tip: 衣物fit指尺寸合适；suit多指款式或颜色适合。

senses.en: Make something work properly or solve a problem.
Attach something firmly in a particular place.
Decide an exact time, price, or arrangement.

ex.en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
ex.zh: 邻居帮我修好了厨房里坏掉的水龙头。

ex.en: Governments should fix weaknesses in existing transport networks before investing in expensive new infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府应先解决现有交通网络的薄弱环节，再投资昂贵的新基础设施。

col: fix something to a wall｜把某物固定在墙上
tip: fix既可修理物品，也可解决问题或确定日期。

senses.en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation
to mark something as needing attention
to become weaker or less energetic

ex.en: A bright flag fluttered above the school gate.
ex.zh: 一面鲜艳的旗帜在校门上方飘扬。

ex.en: Teachers should flag potential learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support.
ex.zh: 教师应尽早指出潜在的学习困难，以便学生获得适当的支持。

tip: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。

senses.en: a set of rooms forming a home within a building
level and smooth, without raised or curved parts
having too little air inside, especially a tyre

ex.en: We rent a small flat above a busy bakery.
ex.zh: 我们在一家生意兴隆的面包店楼上租了一套小公寓。

ex.en: Building affordable flats near public transport could reduce commuting costs for many urban workers.
ex.zh: 在公共交通设施附近建造价格合理的公寓，可以降低许多城市工作者的通勤成本。

tip: “公寓”英式常用 flat，美式常用 apartment。

senses.en: A journey through the air, especially in an aircraft.
The act or ability of moving through the air.
A continuous set of stairs between floors or landings.

ex.en: Our flight leaves early, so we should pack tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的航班出发很早，所以今晚应该收拾好行李。

ex.en: Reducing the number of short domestic flights could lower emissions where reliable rail alternatives already exist.
ex.zh: 在已有可靠铁路替代方案的地区，减少短途国内航班可以降低排放。

col: a flight of stairs｜一段楼梯
tip: a flight of stairs指两层或平台之间的一段楼梯。

senses.en: Water covering land that is normally dry.
To cover with water or become covered with water.
A large amount of something arriving at once.

ex.en: The flood left our garden covered in thick mud.
ex.zh: 洪水退去后，我们的花园覆满了厚厚的淤泥。

ex.en: Restoring wetlands can reduce flood risks by allowing excess rainwater to spread and drain naturally.
ex.zh: 恢复湿地可以让多余雨水自然扩散和排走，从而降低洪灾风险。

col: a flood of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉
tip: 读音与 blood 的元音相同，不与 food 押韵。

senses.en: The surface inside a building that people walk on.
A level of a building.
The bottom surface of a sea, valley, or similar area.

ex.en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙又掉到厨房地板上了。

ex.en: Converting unused upper floors into apartments could help cities address housing shortages without expanding outwards.
ex.zh: 把闲置的较高楼层改建成公寓，有助于城市在不向外扩张的情况下缓解住房短缺。

tip: 英式first floor是二楼；美式first floor是一楼。

senses.en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds.
To produce flowers.

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。

tip: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

senses.en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness

ex.en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
ex.zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。

ex.en: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
ex.zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。

tip: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

senses.en: to move through the air using wings
to travel in or control an aircraft
a small insect with two wings, often found near food

ex.en: Small birds fly over our garden every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早晨都有小鸟飞过我们的花园。

ex.en: Choosing to travel by train rather than fly can significantly reduce the environmental impact of short journeys.
ex.zh: 短途出行选择火车而非飞机，可以显著减少对环境的影响。

col: a swarm of flies｜一群苍蝇
tip: 动词变化fly–flew–flown；苍蝇复数为flies。

senses.en: direct attention or effort towards one particular thing
the main subject receiving attention or effort
image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet

ex.en: Please turn the music down so I can focus.
ex.zh: 请把音乐调小一点，好让我集中注意力。

ex.en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。

tip: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

senses.en: To move behind someone or along a route.
To act according to instructions, rules, or advice.
To understand what someone says or explains.

ex.en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 沿着这条小路走，直到到达木桥。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to follow safety guidelines when using digital devices and online services.
ex.zh: 学校应教导儿童在使用数字设备和网络服务时如何遵守安全准则。

col: follow an argument｜理解论证思路
tip: follow直接接宾语：follow me，不加with。

senses.en: having a liking or affection for someone or something
showing or expressing warmth and affection

ex.en: My grandmother is fond of walking by the river.
ex.zh: 我奶奶喜欢在河边散步。

ex.en: Many adults retain fond memories of teachers who encouraged their curiosity and supported their ambitions.
ex.zh: 许多成年人仍深情地记得那些激发他们好奇心、支持他们志向的老师。

tip: be fond of后接名词或动词-ing，不接to do。

senses.en: Things people or animals eat to live and grow.

ex.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。

ex.en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。

tip: 泛指食物时不可数；foods表示不同种类的食物。

senses.en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment
to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: The realistic plastic spider fooled everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 那只逼真的塑料蜘蛛骗过了聚会上的所有人。

ex.en: Misleading advertisements can fool consumers into buying products that offer little practical benefit.
ex.zh: 误导性广告可能诱使消费者购买几乎没有实际用处的产品。

col: fool someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事
make a fool of yourself｜出洋相
tip: fool作名词称呼别人有贬义；动词可接into doing。

senses.en: Showing poor judgement or a lack of good sense.

ex.en: It was foolish to leave my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。

ex.en: It would be foolish to expand road networks without considering their long-term effects on air quality.
ex.zh: 不考虑道路扩张对空气质量的长期影响就扩大路网，是不明智的。

col: foolish to assume｜贸然假定是不明智的
tip: 常用It is foolish to do表示做某事不明智。

senses.en: the body part below the ankle used for standing and walking
a unit of length equal to twelve inches
the lowest part of something tall or sloping

ex.en: A tiny stone in my shoe hurt my foot.
ex.zh: 鞋里的一颗小石子硌疼了我的脚。

ex.en: Making essential services accessible on foot can encourage physical activity and reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 让人们步行就能获得基本服务，可以促进身体活动并减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: 脚和英尺的复数均为feet；步行用on foot。

senses.en: a game where teams kick a ball into opposing goals
an American game involving carrying, throwing, and kicking an oval ball

ex.en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Local football clubs can strengthen community relationships by bringing together people from different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 地方足球俱乐部能够聚集不同社会背景的人，从而增进社区联系。

tip: 英式football指足球；美式通常指美式橄榄球。

senses.zh: (表示目的、用途等)为了……；(表示方向)向……；(表示时间、距离等)达；计；(表示原因)因为……；(表示对象)对……来说

senses.en: A statement about what is likely to happen in the future.
To say what will probably happen, using available information.

ex.en: The weather forecast says we should expect snow tonight.
ex.zh: 天气预报说今晚可能会下雪。

ex.en: Economists forecast slower growth next year as rising energy costs place greater pressure on businesses.
ex.zh: 经济学家预测，随着能源成本上涨给企业带来更大压力，明年的经济增长将放缓。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常用forecast，也可用forecasted。

senses.en: From or relating to a country other than your own.
Present where it does not naturally belong.
Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.

ex.en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。

ex.en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
ex.zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。

tip: foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。
